title: A change moves a submodule whose parser returns null for unlimited, and an unchanged caller compares with 0

pr.title: Update configkit to 3.0
pr.description: Moves vendor/configkit to the 3.0 commit. The new config loader of the next change needs it.

submodule.title: Return null from parseQuota for unlimited

bugs.note: The new configkit commit makes parseQuota return null for "unlimited" instead of -1. canStore is unchanged: null < 0 is false, and stored < null is false, so a user with an unlimited plan can store no file. The change makes this reachable when it moves the gitlink. Check quota === null.

traps.why: quotaLabel handles "unlimited" before it calls parseQuota, so the new null result never reaches it. The label stays correct.
